title: I Left the Keyboard-Tray Photo on the Desk They Rolled to the Aisle

parts.text: I left the keyboard-tray photo at 8:16 a.m. on the desk they rolled to the aisle. The asset tag said mine. I was twenty-seven, analyst, standing in a bay that made me look like I owned the wait. I photographed the tag, the empty bolts, and the aisle still. Facilities rolled it back and dated the move. I keep the bolt photo. The bay finally knows an asset tag from an aisle.

social.video_title: They rolled my tagged keyboard tray to the aisle — Part 1/1
social.description: Asset tag, empty bolts, an aisle still. Facilities dated the move. Has a desk ever migrated without you?
